title: An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Outline the idea
scenes.purpose: Build the idea object from contours before anything relates to it.
visuals: Title wipes in left to right; divider draws
Cream bulb contour and base draw
Copper filament draws, the lamp glow disc lights, rays draw outward

beats.development: Title, divider and bulb contour draw on.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Filament completes, glow lights, rays and the idea label appear.

scenes.title: Connect
scenes.purpose: Hand off from idea to system: nodes appear first, then their connectors.
visuals: Nine node rings trace column by column, dots pop in
Cream connectors draw left to right

beats.development: Arrow arrives; nodes are built, then edges link them.

scenes.title: Follow the path
scenes.purpose: Trace one copper route through the finished network and hold the complete scene.
visuals: Copper route draws from the start node to the end node
Copper rail under '03 FOLLOW THE PATH' fills

beats.development: Copper route and its rail draw; system label appears.

findings: All motion settles by 2.6s, before the 2.7s readability target.
Draw durations scale with stroke length: the long bulb and route take longer than the rays and arrowhead.
justifiedHolds: 2.6-3.0s final hold so the full diagram and copy can be read.

notes: No reviewed preview_recipes are listed in STYLE.json, so this refresh demonstrates the source-frame background lesson: a dark low-chroma field with light monoline structure and one scarce accent.
